text:
Nikhil P.: hi all -- day 2 here. quick observability onboarding pain points: i can log into Datadog but not sure which api key to use locally vs in our dev k8s clusters. grafana only shows 'Platform Overview' for me, i expect a project folder. sentry login returns 'no org access'. who exactly do i ping for each so i don't spam multiple teams?

onboard-bot: Welcome to Redwood Nikhil! Please follow the onboarding checklist: https://go.redwood/onboard-checklist and request observability access here: https://go.redwood/obs-access-form

Jules (DevEx): welcome, Nikhil! short version: per-user DD keys live in 1Password redwood/integrations/datadog/dev. local: export DD_API_KEY and DD_ENV=dev. k8s: create a secret and reference it in helm values. Grafana: folders are SSO-group gated; i'll add you to `eng` and share the team folder. Sentry: invite should be to your work email; i'll re-send.

Maya (Observability): sent grafana folder link: https://grafana.redwood/team/search-team and re-sent Sentry invite to nikhil@redwood.com. also FYI we have a "New Hire Observability" read-only dashboard with common panels. message me which dashboards you want edit access for.

Ravi (Platform): for k8s secret example: kubectl create secret generic dd-api --from-literal=api-key=$DD_API_KEY -n dev-namespace then set datadog.apiKeyExistingSecret: dd-api in helm. Also set sample rate low for dev to avoid billing hits.

Nikhil P.: awesome, can now see the grafana folder and Sentry invite arrived. created the k8s secret. one small ask: is there a recommended saved search for Sentry to watch first?

Maya (Observability): use saved search "onboarding: errors > last 24h" and bookmark the 'Recent Errors' view. i'll DM it to you and add you to the alert tag list.

Nikhil P.: perfect, thanks everyone! closing out this thread. :)
